notes: Home pets: the profile-style card is now the list view, and the two-column grid is back as it was.

history.notes: Your home screen widget now shows your pet exactly as it is in the app: its breed (Husky included), coat, mood and any rescue conditions. Every pet can now be adopted as a rescue, and the Home pets use the same card as your profile.
A short guide to how Pawse works (also in Me), a calmer Missions screen, tidier settings, a list view for your pets, and the keyboard no longer covers what you type.
One clear number for your pet: wellness. 21 goal-met days in a row heal a rescue, your best run is always kept, and a rescued dog now talks about its past in a way that fits your habit.
Missions are simpler: 21 goal-met days in a row recover your pet, then 21 days of consistency with rewards. After that a slip brings a small issue to clear, not a restart.
Missions: adopt a healthy puppy or rescue a neglected one, pick a 30, 60 or 120-day goal, and heal six conditions with goal-met days in a row. A slip sets recovery back.
The weekly review is simpler: clearer week labels, a choice list for next steps, and the streak chip is gone from the home screen.
Dark mode now uses true black on AMOLED screens, so the background switches off and the pet and cards stand out more.
A small paw shows while the 3D pet loads, and long habit and pet names wrap on pet cards instead of being cut off.
Updates: each update lists every version you've missed, Later stops repeats until the next version, and the Updates screen shows what's ready.
Husky dogs now come in grey, black or red coats, with a white chest and face.
